links.title: Thousands of Authors Ask AI Chatbot Owners to Pay for Use of Their Work
links.description: More than 8,000 authors—including James Patterson, Margaret Atwood and Jonathan Franzen—have signed a letter asking the leaders of leading tech companies to not use their work to train AI systems without permission or compensation.

links.title: Introducing Claude 3.5 Sonnet
links.description: Introducing Claude 3.5 Sonnet—our most intelligent model yet. Sonnet now outperforms competitor models and Claude 3 Opus on key evaluations, at twice the speed.

links.title: GPT-4
links.description: It can generate, edit, and iterate with users on creative and technical writing tasks, such as composing songs, writing screenplays, or learning a user’s writing style.
